title: Sensing the Inflationary Production of Scalars
summary: We review the mechanism by which loops of matter fields contribute to the graviton self-energy during de Sitter inflation. The self-energy is used to quantum-correct the linearized Einstein equations. A Green's function method is employed to obtain exact 1-loop corrections to the plane wave mode functions of gravitational radiation, subject to the usual ambiguity in the initial state.
